title: Arrive, settle in, and meet the Mediterranean
summary: Collect the car, check in at Hersonissos, then use the dependable late opening at CRETAquarium for an easy first outing.
tip: This timeline assumes a 13:00 arrival at Heraklion Airport. If the flight lands after 14:30, move the aquarium to departure day or replace it with a Hersonissos waterfront walk.

activities.title: Land at Heraklion Airport
activities.note: Collect luggage and the rental car before leaving the airport.

activities.title: Drive to Hersonissos
activities.note: Allow extra time around the airport exit and hotel parking.

activities.title: Check in and have a light lunch
activities.note: Keep lunch quick so the aquarium visit does not feel rushed.
September opening is scheduled until 19:00, leaving a comfortable buffer before closing.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Spend the evening close to the hotel and eat whenever energy allows.

title: Kourtaliotiko, Kalypso, and Rethymno
summary: A long cross-island loop combining the gorge waterfalls, a protected swimming cove, and Rethymno’s old town.
tip: Wear grippy shoes for the gorge steps and water shoes at Kalypso. Check gorge access and reserve any required entry before the trip.

activities.title: Drive to Kourtaliotiko Gorge
activities.note: Use the north-coast road through Heraklion and Rethymno; avoid slower inland alternatives.
Descend from the official access point toward Agios Nikolaos chapel and the waterfall area, allowing time for the climb back.
Swim, snorkel and have a simple lunch. The cove is rocky and deep rather than a sandy beach.
Walk the harbour lanes and Fortezza area, then have an early dinner before the return drive.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 19:35.

title: Amazonas Park and Agios Nikolaos
summary: A gentler east-Crete day timed around Amazonas Park opening and a long afternoon beside Lake Voulismeni.
tip: Arrive for the 10:00 opening and ask immediately about that day’s animal-feeding schedule; sessions can change.

activities.title: Drive to Amazonas Park
activities.note: The final section climbs inland from Neapoli.
Allow time for the hillside paths and a scheduled feeding session if available.
Reserve a lake-view table in advance for Saturday.
Circle the lake, explore the harbour and old-town streets, and pause for coffee or a swim at Kitroplatia.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 18:00.

title: Balos Lagoon
summary: The longest single excursion: drive to Kissamos for a Balos-only cruise, then return across the island.
tip: Book a Balos-only boat from Kissamos before committing to these times. Boat schedules and landing conditions can change with weather; arrive at the port at least 45 minutes early.

activities.title: Drive to Kissamos Port
activities.note: Build in one short motorway break and arrive before 09:30.

activities.title: Park and collect boat tickets
activities.note: Bring water, food, sun protection and footwear suitable for wet boarding.

activities.title: Sail to Balos
activities.note: This schedule uses the shorter Balos-only service rather than the later Gramvousa combination cruise.
Swim and explore the lagoon while staying inside marked protected areas.
Have a substantial late lunch before the long drive east; the restaurant does not take reservations.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 20:20. Share driving if possible and take a short break near Rethymno.

title: Matala beach and caves
summary: A deliberately slower day after Balos, with time for the caves, swimming and an unhurried seaside lunch.
tip: Check the archaeological cave opening time the day before; beach access remains available even if the fenced cave area closes early.

activities.title: Drive to Matala
activities.note: Cross the island through the Messara plain.
Visit the rock-cut caves first, then swim before the beach reaches its busiest period.

activities.title: Lunch on the Matala waterfront
activities.note: Choose a shaded table and keep the afternoon flexible.

activities.title: One last swim or village walk
Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 18:05.

title: Seitan Limania and Chania
summary: Reach the Akrotiri cove before the crowds, then spend the afternoon walking and eating in Chania Old Town.
tip: The final descent to Seitan Limania is steep and loose. Wear closed shoes, do not descend in strong wind or rough-sea conditions, and leave valuables out of sight in the car.

activities.title: Drive to Seitan Limania
activities.note: Take a brief rest stop before Chania and expect slower roads on Akrotiri.
Allow roughly 20 minutes each way for the descent and climb, leaving about 90 minutes beside the water.

activities.title: Drive to Chania Old Town
activities.note: Use a signed car park outside the pedestrian old-town lanes.
Reserve ahead and confirm the restaurant’s Tuesday lunch service.
Walk Splantzia, the Venetian harbour, lighthouse waterfront and Topanas lanes at an unhurried pace.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 19:20; add a short motorway break if needed.

title: Elafonissi
summary: A final western expedition with an early start, five hours at the protected coast, and a daylight return.
tip: This is the hardest road day of the trip. If the Balos or Seitan day leaves you tired, replace Elafonissi with a closer beach rather than forcing seven more hours behind the wheel.

activities.title: Drive to Elafonissi
activities.note: Pause briefly near Chania or Kissamos, then continue carefully through the slower western roads.
Walk across the shallow lagoon early, use marked paths and keep away from protected dune vegetation.

activities.title: Early lunch near Elafonissi
activities.note: Eat before starting the long return drive and carry extra water in the car.

activities.title: Return to Hersonissos
activities.note: Expected hotel arrival around 18:30, with a short break included.

title: Departure day
summary: Check out, return the rental car and leave a calm buffer for Heraklion Airport.
tip: Replace the relative times below once the flight departure time is known.

activities.title: Breakfast, pack and check out
activities.note: Confirm the hotel’s checkout time the previous evening.

activities.title: Drive to Heraklion Airport
activities.note: Refuel before the airport approach unless your rental agreement says otherwise.

activities.title: Return the rental car and check in
activities.note: Allow time for the vehicle inspection, bag drop and security.
